candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record shows RBBB on both ECGs plus alternating LAFB (day 1) and LPFB (day 2), which together define trifascicular block. 'Cardiac conduction disease with alternating fascicular block' captures the alternating fascicular component but does not specify RBBB or the trifascicular designation, leaving out a required anatomical component of the benchmark diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the alternating fascicular block component but omits the specific right bundle-branch block (RBBB) that, combined with alternating LAFB/LPFB, constitutes trifascicular block

case_quality_flags: Classic trifascicular block presentation with alternating hemiblocks across consecutive ECGs; RBBB is present on both tracings and is essential to the complete diagnosis
